capture.description: The Corona Tools RS16150B RazorTOOTH Folding Pruning Saw with 10″ Curved Steel Blade is a powerful, portable cutting tool designed for fast, efficient performance in the garden and the outdoors. Built for gardening, tree trimming, and branch cutting, as well as camping, biking, and backpacking, this versatile folding saw delivers aggressive cutting power in a compact, easy-to-carry design. The curved high-carbon steel blade keeps more teeth engaged with every stroke, allowing you to cut through branches, limbs, and green or dry wood quickly and smoothly. Its precision-sharpened teeth provide clean, controlled cuts that reduce binding and help prevent damage to plants when pruning. Designed for comfort and control, the saw features an ergonomic non-slip handle that fits securely in your hand, even in wet or muddy conditions. The folding lock-back design keeps the blade safely locked open during use and securely closed when stored, making it safe to carry in a backpack, tool belt, or camping gear. Whether you're pruning trees and shrubs in the yard, clearing trails, cutting firewood at camp, or handling emergency outdoor tasks, this RazorTOOTH folding pruning saw delivers the durability, cutting power, and portability you need for dependable performance wherever your work or adventure takes you.
